cards.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
cards.core_operation: Interleave generated reasoning traces with environment actions and observations.
cards.relevant_limit: It does not itself assign delayed credit across many failed subtasks.

cards.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
cards.core_operation: Store linguistic reflections derived from feedback and reuse them on later trials.
cards.relevant_limit: The reflection is a free-form summary and can preserve a wrong causal diagnosis.

cards.title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
cards.core_operation: Grow an executable skill library under an automatic curriculum and retrieve skills for new tasks.
cards.relevant_limit: Its skill accumulation setting does not isolate which prior event caused a later software-task failure.

cards.title: Language Agent Tree Search Unifies Reasoning, Acting, and Planning in Language Models
cards.core_operation: Use Monte Carlo tree search with language-model value estimates and reflection.
cards.relevant_limit: Branch expansion can be expensive when one environment transition is a long tool trajectory.

cards.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
cards.core_operation: Search over intermediate thought states using generation, evaluation, and backtracking.
cards.relevant_limit: Thought-state scoring is not equivalent to execution-state verification.

cards.title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
cards.core_operation: Self-supervise where tool calls should be inserted into language-model text.
cards.relevant_limit: The learned call placement does not address multi-step recovery after state-changing actions.

cards.title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
cards.core_operation: Alternate self-generated feedback and output refinement without additional training.
cards.relevant_limit: Self-feedback need not be grounded in an independently observed environment delta.

cards.title: CRITIC: Large Language Models Can Self-Correct with Tool-Interactive Critiquing
cards.core_operation: Use external tools to ground critique before revising an answer.
cards.relevant_limit: Correction quality remains bounded by the selected tool and the critique query.

cards.title: ExpeL: LLM Agents Are Experiential Learners
cards.core_operation: Extract cross-task natural-language insights from successful and failed trajectories for later reuse.
cards.relevant_limit: Aggregated insights can blur task-specific preconditions and competing causal explanations.

cards.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
cards.core_operation: Retrieve, reflect over, and plan from a stream of memory records.
cards.relevant_limit: Importance and recency retrieval are not designed around executable task success.

cards.title: MemoryBank: Enhancing Large Language Models with Long-Term Memory
cards.core_operation: Maintain and update long-term conversational memories with an explicit forgetting mechanism.
cards.relevant_limit: Conversation-level retention provides no direct operation for crediting a tool transition.

cards.title: Reasoning with Language Model is Planning with World Model
cards.core_operation: Use a language model as both world model and policy within planning search.
cards.relevant_limit: Modelled transitions can disagree with real software or API state transitions.

cards.title: AppWorld: A Controllable World of Apps and People for Benchmarking Interactive Coding Agents
cards.core_operation: Evaluate rich multi-app tasks with executable state-based tests and collateral-damage checks.
cards.relevant_limit: Final-state tests reveal failure but do not uniquely locate the causal trajectory step.

cards.title: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
cards.core_operation: Run agents in real computer environments with task-specific setup and execution evaluators.
cards.relevant_limit: GUI grounding and operational knowledge failures can be entangled in the same trace.

cards.title: WebArena: A Realistic Web Environment for Building Autonomous Agents
cards.core_operation: Benchmark agents on self-hosted, realistic websites with functional correctness evaluation.
cards.relevant_limit: Sparse terminal reward leaves many semantically different failed trajectories equivalent.

cards.title: WorkArena: How Capable Are Web Agents at Solving Common Knowledge Work Tasks?
cards.core_operation: Evaluate knowledge-work interactions in a reproducible enterprise web environment.
cards.relevant_limit: Benchmark evaluation does not by itself determine a reusable recovery operation.

cards.title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
cards.core_operation: Evaluate repository-level issue resolution against executable tests from real projects.
cards.relevant_limit: Test outcomes are strong terminal oracles but expose limited process-level attribution.

cards.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
cards.core_operation: Reshape the agent-computer interface to make repository navigation, editing, and execution easier for agents.
cards.relevant_limit: Interface improvements do not decide how evidence from past runs should alter a future policy.

cards.title: Agentless: Demystifying LLM-based Software Engineering Agents
cards.core_operation: Use a fixed localization, repair, and validation pipeline instead of a free-running agent loop.
cards.relevant_limit: A fixed pipeline is a strong simplicity baseline but does not cover arbitrary long-horizon tool workflows.

cards.title: OpenHands: An Open Platform for AI Software Developers as Generalist Agents
cards.core_operation: Provide an open event-stream architecture and sandboxed interaction surface for software agents.
cards.relevant_limit: A platform trace format is infrastructure, not an algorithm for learning from the trace.

cards.title: AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents
cards.core_operation: Compare language-model agents across multiple interactive environments under common evaluation.
cards.relevant_limit: Cross-environment aggregate scores can hide environment-specific failure mechanisms.

cards.title: AgentBoard: An Analytical Evaluation Board of Multi-turn LLM Agents
cards.core_operation: Expose progress and fine-grained capability metrics for multi-turn agent evaluation.
cards.relevant_limit: Analytical metrics diagnose behavior but do not specify a new state-update operation.

cards.title: GAIA: a benchmark for General AI Assistants
cards.core_operation: Evaluate assistants on questions requiring reasoning, multimodality, browsing, and tools.
cards.relevant_limit: Answer correctness offers less state-transition visibility than instrumented software environments.

cards.title: WebShop: Towards Scalable Real-World Web Interaction with Grounded Language Agents
cards.core_operation: Evaluate language agents in a large simulated e-commerce website with grounded goals.
cards.relevant_limit: Reward and action traces do not resolve whether an error arose from retrieval, planning, or grounding.
